verdict.rationale: Jeeves Cash offers multi-currency accounts with up to 5% yield (jeeves-docs-5, jeeves-docs-38), satisfying the 'high-yield savings' half of the story, and there is some automation around FX conversion between Jeeves Cash accounts (jeeves-docs-41) and invoice payment automation (jeeves-docs-27). However, there is no evidence of a distinct 'sub-account' structure or configurable automated transfer/sweep rules to build a cash cushion specifically. Missing for 10: dedicated sub-account creation, rule-based auto-transfer/sweep configuration, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of yield accrual mechanics.
